title: Company Communal Orchestration Protocol — Q3 2026 (WIP)
content:
Executive summary:

This is a working protocol for Q3 2026 company-wide planning: a minimal, repeatable play to align OKRs, shape the exec update narrative, and run the all-hands with clear asks. Treat this as the canonical draft for cross-functional feedback through 2026-02-25.

Why this doc exists:
- We need a compact set of company-level OKRs that balance reliability, cost improvements, and customer enablement for the next quarter.
- We need an all-hands run-of-show that is tight (60–75 minutes) with pre-reads and a clear decision/ask board.
- We want an exec update narrative that surfaces tradeoffs (latency vs. unit cost), upcoming product rollouts (Dedicated beta, Private pilot), and staffing hotspots.

Guiding constraints (ops):
- Keep exec asks to 3 measurable decisions (budget delta, policy change, pilot approval).
- All-hands should be no more than 75 minutes live; <= 20 min narrative, 30 min demos + successes, 25 min live Q&A + breakouts.
- OKRs must be measurable and attributable to 1–2 teams; avoid >3 owners.

Proposed company-level OKRs (draft) — lean set to circulate: 
O1: Reduce customer token latency variability to support 99th pct SLOs
KR1.1: 99th percentile latency at <= 450ms for core hosted models on typical requests (measured weekly).
KR1.2: Reduce multi-region failover time from 180s to <= 60s (simulated DR tests).
Owner: eng-serving-runtime + eng-sre

O2: Improve inference unit economics for high-throughput customers
KR2.1: Achieve 18% lower cost-per-token on benchmark workloads via batching, cache, and quantization profiles.
KR2.2: Ship Redwood Optimize first-wave suggestions and reach 10 pilot customers.
Owner: product-optimize + infra

O3: Grow enterprise readiness & adoption for Private/Dedicated
KR3.1: Complete security attestation checklist for 5 reference customers and close 3 pilots (Dedicated capacity).
KR3.2: Launch V1 of Private deployment installer with automated KMS integration and doc guides.
Owner: product-private + solutions-engineering

O4: Maintain velocity on developer experience and docs to reduce onboarding friction
KR4.1: Reduce time-to-first-successful-API-call for new accounts from median 45 mins to 20 mins.
KR4.2: Ship 6 new quickstart templates and 4 reference apps.
Owner: developer-experience + SDKs

Notes on measurability:
- Metric owners must publish the weekly dashboard (Console -> Team pages) and a short QA note explaining measurement assumptions and significant anomalies.
- If any KR falls behind >25% vs baseline at mid-quarter, schedule a rapid sync within 72 hours.

All-hands plan (draft run-of-show) — target live date: 2026-03-12
Pre-reads (distributed 7 days prior):
- One-pager: Q2 results vs baseline (1p) — finance + product
- New OKRs (this doc) — company-ops
- Demo plan and support ask (engineering)

Live agenda (75 min target):
1) 5 min: Welcome + company context (CEO — high-level north star)
2) 10 min: Quarter in review (CRO + CFO — metrics, wins, gaps)
3) 15 min: Technical spotlight (serving-runtime reliability improvements + short demo)
4) 15 min: Product rollouts (Dedicated beta status, Private pilot updates, Optimize launch plan)
5) 20 min: Customer story + success highlight (solutions engineer + customer video clip)
6) 10 min: Asks & decisions (execs present 3 asks)
7) 0–10 min: Live Q&A (moderated; overflow -> breakouts with team leads)

Logistics and owners:
- All-hands coordinator: Priya Desai (company-ops) — owns invites, pre-reads distribution, room/streaming, recording.
- Tech demo lead: Marcus Ng (eng-serving-runtime) — must rehearse with A/V 48 hours prior.
- Customer story lead: Ben Carter (customer-success) — confirm video and short script.
- Q&A moderator: Lena Ortiz (comms) — collect questions from pre-reads Slack thread, seed live.

Communication plan:
- Pre-reads posted to Confluence (CP-7421) and linked in calendar invite.
- Slack announcement schedule: T-7d (pre-reads), T-2d (reminder + ask for live Qs), T-30m (stream link).
- Record and publish short highlight reel (2–3 min) within 48 hours.

Exec update narrative (for leaders) — 10-slide max skeleton: 
Slide 1: TL;DR (where we are vs. north star)
Slide 2: Q2 outcomes (top 3 quantitative takeaways)
Slide 3: Reliability & SLO story (latency, incidents, regional failover)
Slide 4: Cost story (unit economics, Optimize impact estimate)
Slide 5: Product GTM cadence (Dedicated, Private, hosted roadmap highlights)
Slide 6: Sales/Customer traction and pipeline (customer pilots, ARR-sensitive wins)
Slide 7: People and hiring hotspots (critical roles we need now)
Slide 8: Risks and mitigation (capacity, supply chain for GPUs, compliance gating)
Slide 9: Asks (budget delta, pilot approvals, policy decisions)
Slide 10: Appendix (metrics, tickets, runbooks)

Top-level asks to execs for decision in the all-hands: 
- Approve temporary budget reallocation: +15% GPU on Dedicated pilot pool for Q3 to accelerate low-latency benchmarks (finance + infra ask).
- Approve go/no-go on public Dedicated beta date window (product + sales).
- Approve a 90-day cross-functional task force for Private installs (security, support, solutions).

Risks, open questions, and unresolved tradeoffs (notes):
- Risk: Pushing +15% GPU budget may increase runway consumption; need clear rollback thresholds (suggest: spend > 40% of extra budget without 2 pilot customers triggers rollback).
- Question: Do we require an external pen-test before any Private pilot or will an internal attestation be sufficient for initial reference customers? (security to decide)
- Tradeoff: Tightening SLOs may increase cost-per-token at 95th/99th percentiles; need product/finance tradeoff modeling in two-weeks.

Team asks (what we need from each group):
- Eng-serving-runtime: finalize failover automation RFC by 2026-02-22 (JIRA:INF-2345).
- Product-hosted-api: finalize beta feature gating matrix and rollout thresholds by 2026-02-25.
- Solutions-engineering: identify 5 candidate pilot customers and confirm contact cadence by 2026-02-28.
- Developer-experience: produce 3 new quickstarts (python, node, terraform) by 2026-03-05.
- Finance: prepare runway sensitivity analysis for +15% GPU ops spend by 2026-02-20.

Decision rules for OKR changes mid-quarter:
- Any proposed change to company-level OKRs requires an owners-signed brief + exec sponsor approval.
- Minor re-scopes (<=10% KR target delta) can be approved by the OKR owner and product-ops lead.

Milestone timeline (high level):
- 2026-02-18: Share draft (this doc) for cross-functional feedback (deadline 2026-02-25).
- 2026-02-26: Leadership sync to lock final OKRs and asks.
- 2026-03-03: All-hands rehearsal (full run-through).
- 2026-03-12: All-hands (live).
- 2026-03-14: Publish recording + highlights + decision log.

Open items for feedback (please add to comments or the CP-7421 confluence page):
- Strong preference for limiting live narrative to 20 minutes — reasonable?
- Any conflicts on the +15% Dedicated GPU ask? Alternatives if no approval (scope reduction, delayed beta).
- Acceptable rollback thresholds for any extra spend?

Quick checklist for contributors (working):
- [ ] Product: finalize OKR wording and owners.
- [ ] Eng: rehearse demo and confirm infra for streaming.
- [ ] Comms: draft announcement and highlight reel storyboard.
- [ ] Finance: runway sensitivity + ask language.
- [ ] SRE: schedule DR test window and publish initial outcomes.

Notes to self / fringe ideas (raw):
- Consider a 10-minute customer Q&A panel instead of single customer story (might be higher engagement).
- Use a small poll during live (in-stream) to capture adoption intent for new Optimize features.
- Keep appendix with raw numbers (latency histogram, cost per 1M tokens) to answer granular questions.

References & links (for reviewers):
- Confluence: CP-7421 Q3 planning hub
- JIRA: INF-2345 failover automation RFC
- Slack: #all-hands planning thread (pinned messages)
- GitHub: repo/infra-deck PR#412 (slides + demo notes)

Next steps (action owner):
- Aisha: consolidate feedback and send updated doc on 2026-02-26 (after leadership lock).
- Priya: book rehearsal and confirm A/V by 2026-03-01.
- Marcus: ensure demo runbook and fallback video ready by 2026-03-03.

This is intentionally compact — add comments inline and mark any non-trivial edits with [REVIEW] so I can track changes.

-- end of draft (Aisha)
